Notes: a. Numbers have been rounded to the nearest tens. b. Numbers may not add up to the totals due to rounding. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Energy Market Authority. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
